post.title: Ticketing: 12% of Live Nation's sales, ~half its op. income
post.ig:
Ticketing is 12% of Live Nation's sales. Nearly half its adjusted operating income.

In 2025, the Ticketing segment made $1.1B in adjusted operating income on $3.1B of revenue, an adjusted operating margin near 37% (concerts: 3.3%).
Ticketmaster says it typically keeps about $5 of a $100 all-in ticket and that venues get most of the fee; it sold 346M fee-bearing tickets in 2025.
An FTC rule requiring all-in ticket prices took effect May 12, 2025. In April 2026 a jury in the states' antitrust case found Live Nation and Ticketmaster liable for monopolization. As of September 2026, the companies were challenging the verdict, and a DOJ settlement proposed in March 2026 awaited court review.

Sources: Live Nation FY2025 10-K and results, FTC (16 CFR 464), court reporting (CNN, Music Business Worldwide).
